title: Run Through a Seam Handoff
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be machines with $k$ work tapes over a common alphabet, with state sets $S_1,S_2$. Choose $exit\in S_1$ and $entry\in S_2$. Suppose the run of $M_1$ from configuration $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ after $T_1$ steps, with state $exit$, and avoids $exit$ at every earlier time. Suppose the run of $M_2$ from $c_1$ with its state replaced by $entry$ reaches configuration $c_3$ after $T_2$ steps. Then the seam-composed machine, started from $c_0$ with its state embedded in the left component, reaches $c_3$ with its state embedded in the right component after $T_1+1+T_2$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ work tapes and a common symbol alphabet and input
Configurations $c_0,c_1$ of $M_1$, configuration $c_3$ of $M_2$, and natural numbers $T_1,T_2$
The run from $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ at time $T_1$
The run avoids $exit$ at every time $t<T_1$
The run of $M_2$ from $c_1$ with state replaced by $entry$ reaches $c_3$ at time $T_2$
